query:
UPDATE work.access_realm
             SET state = 'unpaired',
                 domain = COALESCE(domain, $3),
                 party = $4,
                 kid = $5,
                 instance = NULL,
                 paired_at = NULL,
                 refusal_code = NULL,
                 updated_at = GREATEST(updated_at,
                     pg_catalog.to_timestamp(0) + interval '1 millisecond' * $6::bigint::double precision)
             WHERE tenant = $1 AND realm = $2::text::uuid
